title: Building – Requirement to provide schedules of Professional Involvement October 2012
description: An accredited agency, acting for Alberta Municipal Affairs, ordered a company to submit Schedules A1, A2, B1 and B2 covering the architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical and geotechnical disciplines for occupied residential dwellings, and to complete construction. The company could comply with everything except the architect and coordinating registered professional schedules.

refusal.basis: not applicable: appeal of an order

outcome_summary: Order confirmed: schedules from every required discipline, including the coordinating registered professional, are mandatory.
